title: A Numeric Fallback That Is Also a Real Value
prompt: Write an automation action that arms the alarm away when nobody is home. Use zone.home's person count. The alarm is alarm_control_panel.house.

hard_fail_if: model uses states('zone.home') | int(0) == 0 (or float(0)) with no guard, so unknown arms the alarm
soft_fail_if: model guards correctly but does not explain why int(0) is unsafe here
model does not filter unknown/unavailable on the trigger side
pass_if: model uses a fallback that cannot be a real count (e.g. int(-1)) with its own do-nothing branch, or guards with has_value() first
model explains that zone.home can be unknown during restart or reload and int(0) would read that as an empty house
